43143: Raishin is a survivor of the Akabane clan, a prestigious clan of puppeteers. He attends the Royal Academy in hopes to improve his skills and become the best in the world and with intent to avenge his family.
43144: Yaya is Raishin's puppet who takes the form of a raven-haired teenage girl. She is abnormal in the sense that her appearance and personality strongly resemble that of a human. She adores Raishin and often teases him. Yaya was named for her indestructibility.
47589: She is a second year puppeteer in The Royal Academy of Machinart and also ranked withing the top thirteen members (the Rounds) of the Night Party. The automaton she owns' is a dragon-type automaton called Sigmund. She wants to become the Wiseman.
56833: Third Year puppeteer and Loki's older sister. Just like him, she has red eye color and pearl gray hair. Frey's automaton is Rabbi, a dog-type automatic doll.
56837: Frey's brother and member of the thirteen party (Rounds). His automaton is Cherubim, a humanoid type doll with plate armour appearance.
89651: Irori is a woman who has a pale skin tone, long, flowing silver hair, purple eyes and wears light-colored lipstick. Her choice of attire is an indigo-colored kimono that is secured by a teal-colored obi.
89652: Komurasaki is Yaya's and Irori's younger sister, she is the youngest Automaton "daughter" of Shoko Karyusai. cheerful and optimistic girl who smiles frequently, She is rather cheeky and tends to make sexual jokes.
